newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche - no early sale of industry stakes.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche - no early sale of industry stakes.

text.p: Germany's largest commercial bank, Deutsche Bank AG, said on Tuesday it was unlikely to sell off its industrial stakes in the near-term for tax reasons.

"We would be very happy if we could free up a part of the reserves that are currently invested in a few industrials to put into other areas," Deutsche finance chief Juergen Krumnow said at a conference.
But he added that such transactions would make no sense if the company then had to give 60 percent of the profits from the sales to the tax authorities.

Speaking at a conference on shareholder value, Krumnow said the bank was in discussions with the government over a possible solution to the problem, but accepted that the bank might have to wait for tax reform that is not scheduled until 1999.
Deutsche has stakes in a number of large German groups including industrial giants Daimler-Benz AG, Metallgesellschaft AG and construction group Philipp Holzmann AG.
